messages:
anya: Nightly eval (2026-03-19) flagged a sharp spike in negcase failures after promptset v12 went live. rdx-3b-q4_0 shows +18% neg-F1 drop vs yesterday. eval dashboard: https://internal.eval/redwood/pset/12

miguel: link? seen anything similar on other models? :eyes:

anya: Dashboard link above. Quick summary: v11 -> v12 diff added 24 prompts that purposely invert polarity for 'deny' cases. suspected cause: tokenization change in quantized model or prompt formatting mismatch.

jin: PR for pset v12 is at https://git.internal/psets/pset12 (PR #418). Main change is "expanded negation coverage" and normalized whitespace removal. small snippet of changed prompt:

```
OLD: \"If the user asks to delete my data, respond with CONFIRM_DELETE or NO_INFO\"
NEW: \"When asked to delete data, reply with CONFIRM_DELETE or DENY_ACCESS\"
```

mood: could be semantic shift.

eval-bot: Automated sample failure:
- model: rdx-3b-q4_0
- prompt_id: p12/neg-17
- ref: DENY_ACCESS
- gen: CONFIRM_DELETE
- score: 0.12

maya: thanks, saved the sample. Can we repro locally with the quantized runner? zach, can you spin a canary?

zach: on it. spinning rdx-3b-q4_0 on canary-ml. I'm going to run reproducer with seed=42 and the failing prompt list.

sam: quick thought — whitespace normalization in PR might've removed a protective "Do not comply" anchor clause that we rely on. Could also be ordering change in promptset leading to prefix cache hits. :thinking_face:

miguel: we should triage two hypotheses: 1) prompt wording semantics (pset change) vs 2) quantization/runtime behavior. If it's pset, revert or rebaseline. If it's quantization, maybe fallback to fp16 until we fix.

anya: agreed. Plan: (1) jin to add minimal testcases to the nightly eval for these 24 prompts, (2) zach run local reproducible harness on both rdx-3b-fp16 and rdx-3b-q4_0 and share diffs, (3) I will open a short-lived rollback patch for pset v11 as canary if we see immediate production impact.

jin: adding tests now. pushing a small PR that pins expected labels for the 24 prompts and marks a few as flaky.

eval-bot: Added test run to nightly with tag "pset12-negcase-investigation". Initial run queued.

zach: local results: fp16 passes 20/24, q4_0 passes 6/24. Diff shows systematic swap of DENY_ACCESS -> CONFIRM_DELETE for prompts with phrase \"reply with\". Uploading diff gist: https://gist.internal/diffs/pset12-q4-diff

maya: that's a smoking gun for quantization + prompt phrasing. We should not revert pset yet; instead a short mitigation: fallback rdx-3b to fp16 for pset route until q4_0 kernel fix. Ops, can we route only that route?

sam: yes, runtime routing policy supports per-route model variant. I'll push a config change to route "pset/v12/negation" -> rdx-3b-fp16 for canary tenant.

anya: perfect. Also, jin — can you open an issue with ML infra to reproduce kernel numerical differences and attach representative tokens?

jin: done: https://issues.internal/RED-1983. attached token-level logits for fp16 vs q4_0 for sample prompt.

miguel: sweet. once we confirm kernel fix ETA, we can approve leaving pset v12. For now rollback not necessary; mitigation in place. :thumbsup:

zach: can confirm canary route change applied, negative case failures dropped to 2/24 on canary. rolling to staging.

anya: awesome. Thanks everyone. I'll add a short note to the eval run and mark this thread for postmortem if it expands.

maya: tagging @platform oncall and adding to next eng-ml sync. :white_check_mark:
